summary.text: Bruce Fine, an independent and self-described former Republican who says he has worked as a farmer, marine mechanic, and journalist, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House in Tennessee's 2nd District to Tim Burchett.
He says he left the GOP because both parties 'abandoned everyday people.'

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists a high school diploma for Fine from North Miami Beach Senior High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Florida in 1997; his survey describes a B.S. from the University of Florida.
He describes himself as a farmer, marine mechanic, and journalist who has worked across trades and industries, from farming and fishing to mechanics and journalism, and says he is not a politician.
Fine says he left the Republican Party because both parties have abandoned everyday people, and he ran as an independent.
During the campaign, he ran on cost of living, local healthcare clinics and hospitals, education, and the national debt.
He received 0.7% of the vote to Tim Burchett's 57.7%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
